title: [Critical DX Issue] Antigravity IDE Hardcoded MCP Tool Limit (100) & Configuration Fragmentation with Gemini CLI

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue is a feature request proposing new capabilities and architectural enhancements: unifying MCP configuration management across Gemini CLI and Antigravity IDE, and introducing dynamic pagination or removal of tool limits in Antigravity IDE. Since this requests new enhancements rather than reporting a bug or regression in existing functionality, it is classified as FEATURE.
